description: This file defines the 'ModuleClass' class which represents a custom module in the vtiger CRM system, specifically handling the 'Payslip' entity. It includes properties for database table mappings, list views, search capabilities, security, and import/export functionalities, along with methods for constructing queries, handling module events, and managing relations.

classes.name: ModuleClass
classes.description: Represents a custom module 'Payslip' in the vtiger CRM, extending CRMEntity with properties and methods to handle database interactions, list views, security, import/export, and module lifecycle events.
